authorResult.summary: Implemented SAC-245 as a static TypeScript/Vite reading queue with transactional localStorage persistence, validation, status changes, filtering, counts, editing, deletion, error recovery, accessible controls, and safe literal text rendering. All 23 OpenSpec tasks are complete. Trusted checks passed: 31/31 tests, TypeScript/build, strict OpenSpec validation, local preview health, and static asset verification. Published and exercised the immutable preview at https://b4729f5d.deos-preview-6788ae86271dbb20.pages.dev. Seven hosted browser scenarios completed with 20 inspected screenshots and no console errors; nine images and one Showboat record were selected for review.
assumptions: Desktop-only scope uses a minimum 1100px page width; no phone-specific layout was added.
Persistence is intentionally limited to the current browser and preview origin.
The hosted preview contains the latest application build; later edits only completed task checkboxes.
